summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Special General Meeting of Shareholders held on July 27, 2026. The meeting was initially adjourned for lack of quorum, reconvened, and shareholders approved the sole agenda item as described in the prior notice and proxy statement. No specific special-situation transaction details (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, capital return) are disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting outcome report for a foreign private issuer and does not indicate a special situation event.
